command.name: Golden Wrath
verbatim: Rounds 1, 4, 7, 10: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +110%). If Sunfyre is below 75% troop capacity, deal damage to a second Enemy within adjacency. If below 50%, also deal Fire Damage (Damage Rate: +55%) to the same targets and have a 50% chance to afflict Burn for 2 round(s).

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Wit
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase your Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Radiant Majesty
verbatim: Start of Each Round: Increase the Damage Dealt by +5% of the other Ally with the most troops until the end of the round.
If you are below 75% Troop Capacity, apply this effect to both other allies instead.
If you are below 50% Troop Capacity, also apply this effect to yourself.

habits.name: Extinguish
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Fire Damage Dealt by -13% of 1 Enemy that deals Fire Damage until the end of combat.

habits.name: The King's Ire
habits.verbatim: Each Round: The first time any ally receives Fire Damage, deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane that deals Fire Damage (Damage Rate: +50%). Additionally, reduce the target's Intelligence by -15% (enhanced by Instinct) for 2 round(s). This effect can only trigger once per round.

habits.name: Unbroken Splendor
verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Fire Damage Received by -7% until the end of combat.

Start of Each Round: If you are below 50% troop capacity, reduce your Damage Received by -7% until the end of the round. Additionally, there is a 25% chance to Cleanse yourself of 1 Negative effect that increases your Damage Received (prioritizes the Vulnerable condition).

habits.name: Adaptive Glory
verbatim: Each Round: The first time you Receive Damage, activate one of the following effects based on the type of damage received.
Fire Damage: Apply Recovery to yourself (Recovery Rate: +30% enhanced by Instinct).
Tactical Damage: Increase the Damage Dealt of the Ally with the most troops by +12% for 1 round(s).
Physical Damage (excluding Basic Attacks): Reduce the Damage Dealt of the Enemy with the most troops by -12% for 1 round(s).
Basic Attack: Increase your Instinct by +12% and Initiative by +6% for 1 round(s).
